title: Compact bounded YouTube bibliography pipeline
description: A ten-minute, phrase-only bibliography run with storyboard thumbnails and a timestamped continuation path.

diagrams.title: Compact bounded bibliography pipeline
diagrams.description: Captions move through phrase curation, bounded verification, and portable export. A cap returns a continuation timestamp.
diagrams.accessibility: Start with a YouTube URL, retrieve captions, filter from the optional timestamp, extract meaningful multi-word phrases, globally deduplicate them, verify only the shortlist, then show results and a Markdown export. If the ten-minute or forty-hit limit is reached, save the cursor and offer a continuation URL.
